stills.prompt: The same chamber as @room, same camera position, columns, arched door, steps and chair. Change only the material and light: the walls, columns, dome and floor are polished black marble threaded with fine hairline veins of antique gold (#C6A94F), faint and mostly washed out, glinting only where light touches them. The oculus is small and dim, showing no sky; one narrow shaft of warm gold light falls from it through visible dust onto the wet floor. The arched door stands slightly ajar with warm amber light in the gap. Beside the chair with the coat over its back, a low stone ledge holds a dark stoneware cup. Low-key: everything outside the beam and the door gap falls to near-black. No daylight, no blue or white light, no grey stone, no glowing lines, no fire, no people, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
